extracted.intended_audience: researcher groups, lab teams, and community projects that evaluate preprints and want to showcase those evaluations on Sciety
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for groups or communities that evaluate preprints on how to present and manage their reviews so they appear on Sciety, including platform choices, setup steps, and ways to measure and scale activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a group on Sciety
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fill in our group joining form to have your group created on Sciety and we'll do the rest :). The Sciety team can set up a group page so your reviews are showcased in one place on the web.

rubrics_metrics.name: If new to preprint evaluation, consider PREreview
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are new to the world of preprint evaluation, then PREreview can help.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PREreview's mission is to bring more equity and transparency to scholarly peer review by supporting and empowering communities of researchers, particularly those at early stages of their career (ECRs) and historically excluded, to review preprints in a process that is rewarding to them. They offer advice and hands-on article review workshops, and articles reviewed by PREreview communities appear in the PREreview group page on Sciety.

rubrics_metrics.name: Host evaluations on Hypothes.is (recommended for active groups)
rubrics_metrics.description: A hypothes.is basic user account might be your best option to showcase these on Sciety.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set up a hypothes.is user with the name of your reviewing group (e.g. https://hypothes.is/users/theunjournal). Install the Hypothes.is Chrome extension, find the preprint you wish to evaluate and open the associated article page, and post your evaluation/review in the public channel. After posting, fill in the Sciety group joining form so Sciety can create/recognize your group.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Kotahi for end-to-end evaluating & curating (scaleable workflow)
rubrics_metrics.description: Kotahi is the platform for you if you want to import preprints and manage an end-to-end peer review and publishing workflow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Kotahi is a low-cost option appealing to groups with multiple members and roles who want to scale up. Built-in features support PRC workflows, including customisable submission, review and evaluation forms, author & reviewer email invitations, task schedulers and the option to register DOIs. If you want to spend less time following up with stakeholders and more time evaluating, Kotahi is recommended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decide platform based on your group's stage and needs
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose the best option for you depending on where you are in your journey (just starting, already evaluating, or curating/publishing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Sciety team is available to offer advice to help you choose among options like PREreview, hypothes.is, or Kotahi; select a platform that matches your desired level of formality, scale, and technical workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider whether to create your own web/social presence
rubrics_metrics.description: Do you need your own web presence?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There are plenty of free options to create a website, but consider the time it takes to maintain your web presence and avoid duplicating your efforts in multiple places. Sciety is developing group home pages to offer you a place on the web to showcase your work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor engagement with Sciety data dashboards
rubrics_metrics.description: How do you know if your efforts are playing out?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sciety provides you with rich data dashboards to give you an overview of your curation activity so you can see who is engaging with your work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use AI-assisted article recommendations to keep up with preprints
rubrics_metrics.description: How do you keep up with the amount of preprints being published in your subject area?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sciety combines multiple sources into AI-assisted article recommendations. Decide what to read or evaluate next based on what you have read or evaluated previously.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid duplicating effort across platforms
rubrics_metrics.description: Don't spread effort too thin by maintaining multiple overlapping presences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When creating web or social media presences, weigh the maintenance cost and risk of duplicating effort; consider using Sciety group pages as a consolidated place to showcase reviews.
